reason: Legacy emits server-hostname/server-port when config/dev? is true (the self-hosted image runs in dev mode); dev-only tooling keys.

Legacy serves flushed stream segments as S3 file URLs plus inline content for the buffered tail; this server always inlines content. The reader consumes files-then-content, so delivered bytes are identical (asserted via the folded reader state).

An add-attr step whose attr map is garbage (`{id: "x"}`) reaches the legacy SQL layer and surfaces as a 500 `sql-exception`; this server rejects it as a 400 `validation-failed` on parse. The CLI never sends such a step (its steps come from @instantdb/platform convertTxSteps) and only prints `message` on failure either way.
